scope: 64 positive-control/catalog/uncalibrated-proxy z>12 review rows; distinct source grouping at <=0.25 arcsec; not a complete survey
source_selection_limit: Only z_best or z_phot>9 and baseline controls were downloaded; no quick fit was run on the other 79,368 catalog entries.
calibration_limit: Proxy values can be nonphysical >1 at ~1e-13 floating-point; no calibrated class odds. Known low-z/9-11 objects receive high z>12 scores.
image_limit: Figures are automated coadded SCI/WHT views; native disjoint exposures, slit/shutter/bad pixel maps not examined. GitHub image pixels were not accessible to this referee environment.
nircam_limit: No independently associated NIRCam flux/limits or filter-convolved SEDs.
literature_scope: Bounded public web exact-source and sky-coordinate checks, MNRAS 2026 Table 1, ApJ 2026 Tang Table B1, Hviding 2025 RUBIES, GLASS 10003 and JADES 58975; no exhaustive per-source ADS/arXiv. The suggested_followup_queries are search prompts, not receipts proving every query was executed.
